jori.description.fullbright: Lifts the brightness cap so dark places stay visible.
jori.description.minimap: Shows a map of your surroundings and your coordinates in the top right. Place pins on the map screen; each pin gets a beam of light.
jori.description.peek: Hover over a shulker box to see its contents as icons.
jori.description.placer: Keeps blocks placed by holding the button from stacking up or drifting off target.
jori.description.refill: Refills your hand from the inventory the moment you use up the item you are holding.
jori.description.sorter: Adds a sort button to the inventory and chest screens.
jori.description.timber: Breaking one log with an axe fells the whole tree.
jori.description.xray: Hides everything but ores and chests and lights them up.
jori.description.zoom: Zooms in while you hold the key.
